newsitem.title: TURKEY: Ford, Koc to equalise stakes in Turkish Otosan.
newsitem.headline: Ford, Koc to equalise stakes in Turkish Otosan.

text.p: Ford Motor Company and Turkish industrial conglomerate Koc Holding agreed to equalise their equity stakes in their Turkish car and commercial vehicle producing joint venture Otosan Otomobil Sanayii, Koc said in a statement.
It said sides agreed in principle following talks which began in late October.

The amount of Otosan shares to be transferred to Ford from the Koc group will be set after Otosan's founder shares are cancelled and its marketing arm Otosan Pazarlama is merged into Otosan to raise its capital.

"According to current figures and 1996 balance sheet estimates, the Otosan stake to be transferred to Ford is forecast at around 12-13 percent," Koc said in the statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange.
Ford currently holds a 30 percent stake in Otosan, Koc Holding and its investment arm Koc Yatirim have a total 39.44 percent, Koc family and other Koc group firms have 14.42 percent.
"It currently seems suitable from the point of view of management to keep Koc Holding's (27.15 percent) and Koc Yatirim's (12.29 percent) stakes in Otosan," Koc said.
Sides aimed to finish the process of equalising the stakes by the end of May 1997, it added.
